f3_program: collection("kimberly.earrings", "earring", "kimberly", source("Kim has a bunch of shiny new earrings"))
collection("kimberly.trade_gumballs", "gumball", "kimberly", source("give Kim 9 gumballs for each pair of earrings"))

transfer("bring_earrings_day_1", "kimberly", at("kimberly.earrings.pair_count", "current"), at("friend.earrings.pair_count", "current"), 3, source("On the first day, Kim brings her 3 pairs of earrings"))

transfer("bring_earrings_day_2", "kimberly", at("kimberly.earrings.pair_count", "current"), at("friend.earrings.pair_count", "current"), scale(event_field("bring_earrings_day_1", "quantity"), 2), source("On the second she brings her twice as many"))

transfer("bring_earrings_day_3", "kimberly", at("kimberly.earrings.pair_count", "current"), at("friend.earrings.pair_count", "current"), "kimberly.earrings.brought.day_3.pair_count", source("On the third day, she brings 1 less than she brought on the second day"))
offset("kimberly.earrings.brought.day_3.pair_count", event_field("bring_earrings_day_2", "quantity"), -1, "pair", source("On the third day, she brings 1 less than she brought on the second day"))

transfer("receive_gumballs_day_1", "friend", at("friend.gumballs.count", "current"), at("kimberly.trade_gumballs.count", "current"), scale(event_field("bring_earrings_day_1", "quantity"), 9), source("She agrees to give Kim 9 gumballs for each pair of earrings"))

transfer("receive_gumballs_day_2", "friend", at("friend.gumballs.count", "current"), at("kimberly.trade_gumballs.count", "current"), scale(event_field("bring_earrings_day_2", "quantity"), 9), source("She agrees to give Kim 9 gumballs for each pair of earrings"))

transfer("receive_gumballs_day_3", "friend", at("friend.gumballs.count", "current"), at("kimberly.trade_gumballs.count", "current"), scale(event_field("bring_earrings_day_3", "quantity"), 9), source("She agrees to give Kim 9 gumballs for each pair of earrings"))
consume("daily_gumball_consumption", "kimberly", at("kimberly.trade_gumballs.count", "current"), 3, source("Kim eats 3 gumballs a day"))
query("value", "kimberly.trade_gumballs.duration.day_count")
assumptions: “She” in the trade agreement refers to the friend, and the earrings brought on each day are exchanged under that agreement.

f3_program: collection("pete.bag.marbles", "marble", "bag", source("Pete has a bag with 10 marbles"))
observe(at("pete.bag.marbles.count", "initial"), 10, "count", source("Pete has a bag with 10 marbles"))
member("pete.bag.marbles", "pete.bag.marbles.blue", source("40% are blue"))
member("pete.bag.marbles", "pete.bag.marbles.red", source("the rest are red"))
percent_of(at("pete.bag.marbles.blue.count", "initial"), at("pete.bag.marbles.count", "initial"), 40, source("40% are blue"))
partition("pete.bag.marbles", at("pete.bag.marbles.count", "initial"), source("40% are blue and the rest are red"))

transfer("trade_red_marbles", "pete", at("pete.bag.marbles.red.count", "current"), at("friend.marbles.red.count", "current"), "pete.bag.marbles.red.traded.count", source("His friend will trade him two blue marbles for every red one"))

transfer("trade_blue_marbles", "friend", at("friend.marbles.blue.count", "current"), at("pete.bag.marbles.blue.count", "current"), scale(event_field("trade_red_marbles", "quantity"), 2), source("His friend will trade him two blue marbles for every red one"))
observe(at("pete.bag.marbles.red.count", "after_trade"), 1, "count", source("Pete keeps 1 red marble"))
query("remaining_count", "pete.bag.marbles", "after_trade")

assumptions: The requested individual-sock total requires the unstated conversion of one pair into two socks; F3-v1 does not allow inventing that unit or denomination conversion.

f3_program: collection("cutlery_drawer.pieces", "cutlery_piece", "cutlery drawer", source("There are 6 forks in the cutlery drawer"))
member("cutlery_drawer.pieces", "cutlery_drawer.forks", source("6 forks in the cutlery drawer"))
member("cutlery_drawer.pieces", "cutlery_drawer.knives", source("9 more knives than forks"))
member("cutlery_drawer.pieces", "cutlery_drawer.spoons", source("twice as many spoons as knives"))
member("cutlery_drawer.pieces", "cutlery_drawer.teaspoons", source("half as many teaspoons as forks"))
observe(at("cutlery_drawer.forks.count", "initial"), 6, "count", source("There are 6 forks in the cutlery drawer"))
offset(at("cutlery_drawer.knives.count", "initial"), at("cutlery_drawer.forks.count", "initial"), 9, "count", source("There are 9 more knives than forks"))
multiple(at("cutlery_drawer.spoons.count", "initial"), at("cutlery_drawer.knives.count", "initial"), 2, source("there are twice as many spoons as knives"))
fraction_of(at("cutlery_drawer.teaspoons.count", "initial"), at("cutlery_drawer.forks.count", "initial"), 1, 2, source("half as many teaspoons as forks"))
add("add_forks", "unspecified", at("cutlery_drawer.forks.count", "current"), 2, source("2 of each cutlery is added to the drawer"))
add("add_knives", "unspecified", at("cutlery_drawer.knives.count", "current"), 2, source("2 of each cutlery is added to the drawer"))
add("add_spoons", "unspecified", at("cutlery_drawer.spoons.count", "current"), 2, source("2 of each cutlery is added to the drawer"))
add("add_teaspoons", "unspecified", at("cutlery_drawer.teaspoons.count", "current"), 2, source("2 of each cutlery is added to the drawer"))
query("sum", "cutlery_drawer.pieces", "current")
assumptions: “2 of each cutlery” refers to two of each of the four listed types; the passive sentence does not identify the actor performing the additions.

f3_program: observe(at("kristy.basic_salary.hourly_rate", "this_month"), 7.5, "dollar_per_hour", source("basic salary of $7.50 per hour"))
observe(at("kristy.work.duration", "this_month"), 160, "hour", source("she worked for 160 hours"))

rate_relation(at("kristy.basic_salary.amount", "this_month"), at("kristy.basic_salary.hourly_rate", "this_month"), at("kristy.work.duration", "this_month"), source("earns a basic salary of $7.50 per hour"))
observe(at("kristy.sales.amount", "this_month"), 25000, "dollar", source("sold $25000 worth of items"))
percent_of(at("kristy.commission.amount", "this_month"), at("kristy.sales.amount", "this_month"), 16, source("a 16% commission on everything she sells"))

sum_relation(at("kristy.total_earnings.amount", "this_month"), at("kristy.basic_salary.amount", "this_month"), at("kristy.commission.amount", "this_month"), source("earns a basic salary of $7.50 per hour plus a 16% commission on everything she sells"))

percent_of(at("kristy.monthly_budget.amount", "this_month"), at("kristy.total_earnings.amount", "this_month"), 95, source("Her monthly budget for food, clothing, rent, transportation, bills and savings is 95% of her total monthly earnings"))

difference_relation(at("kristy.insurance.allocation.amount", "this_month"), at("kristy.total_earnings.amount", "this_month"), at("kristy.monthly_budget.amount", "this_month"), source("the rest will be put towards insurance"))
query("value", at("kristy.insurance.allocation.amount", "this_month"))
